# <span id="aanchor202"></span> PPA Editor

Use the PPA Editor to apply a volume, energy and/or mass adjustment to a specific datetime range, contract day(s), or a contract month after meter data has been closed. Once the PPA is applied, the data will then be saved to the PPA columns within the database.

The PPA Editor can also be used to review PPAs for gas and liquid meters and create PPAs for gas meters.

To access the PPA Editor, go to **Open** \> **PPA Editor**. A list of existing PPAs for a selected meter will display. You can select a range of rows and right-click to display the cumulative PPA amounts. Use the Time Filter radio buttons to narrow the PPAs displayed to a particular month range based on production month or accounting month.

If you select a list or location, you can scroll through the meters to see any PPAs.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 510;height: 330;" />

<div class="procedure">

To create a new PPA:

1.  Click the **New** button. 
2.  Select the desired date range and meter. 
3.  When saving the PPA, the date range selected will be checked to verify that all the data in that time period is closed. PPAs cannot be applied to data that has not been closed. If some of the data is not closed, a warning will display and the PPA will not be saved.
4.  Enter the volume and/or energy adjustment amount and an edit reason. 
5.  Select a month to account for the volume and/or energy. 
6.  Click **OK** to apply the PPA.

To create a PPA in the Volume Editor:

1.  Go to **Open** \> **Volume Editor**.
2.  Select a closed meter to be adjusted.
3.  Make the necessary edits to the meter data and save.

If the "Apply Immediate" [System Configuration](../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Configuration/System%20Configuration%20-%20Approvals%20Tab.md) option is specified, a "P" will display in the left column of the Volume Editor. If the "Approval Required" option is specified, a "+/-" will display in the left column, indicating that approval is pending.

A meter message is also generated, notifying specified contacts that a PPA is now pending approval. Users can view all PPAs pending approval by going to **Review** \> **Approvals**.

</div>

After a PPA is applied and the affected data has been rolled up, the results of the PPA can be viewed in several reports, such as the Volume Statement reports, and in the rollup viewers.

If the flow data on a closed meter is changed such that the original values are reverted following a previous PPA, a new PPA record is created with all values set to zero to indicate that the original values did not need to be adjusted.
